analysis.research_question_and_background: Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), remains a public health priority. This study aimed to develop a rapid assay for quantifying infectious MPXV across clinical and environmental matrices in Guangdong Province, China.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined 23 clinical fluid specimens from 15 mpox patients, 337 surface swabs and 53 domestic wastewater samples from patient living environments, and 498 terminal wastewater samples from flights and sewage treatment plants collected between June 2023 and August 2024.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed a propidium monoazide-assisted qPCR (PMA-qPCR) assay that selectively amplifies DNA from intact virions, and embedded it within the Guangdong provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention surveillance network. Co-incubation with 50 μM PMA and 0.005% SDS effectively blocked amplification of non-infectious DNA, and the assay showed quantitative concordance with the standard plaque assay.
analysis.main_results: PMA-qPCR discriminated infectious from non-infectious virus. Infectious MPXV loads were highest in skin lesions and anal swabs, exceeding throat swabs by more than 100-fold. Among surface samples, 41.54% (140/337) tested positive for MPXV DNA by qPCR, but only 25.71% (36/140) of these contained infectious virus at low loads (126.79 ± 93.57 PFU/mL). For wastewater, 11.32% (6/53) of domestic samples from patient living environments tested positive by qPCR, yet no infectious MPXV was detected. No MPXV DNA was detected in 498 terminal wastewater samples from flights or sewage treatment plants.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: PMA-qPCR provides a practical tool for rapid cross-matrix quantification of infectious MPXV. Direct contact with skin lesions or anal secretions likely dominates transmission, whereas environmental persistence is limited.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform surveillance strategies by highlighting the importance of testing clinical samples for infectious virus and the limited environmental persistence of MPXV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study did not include a comparison with other assays or a larger sample size from different geographical regions, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the specific context and sample size.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a propidium monoazide-assisted qPCR (PMA-qPCR) assay to quantify infectious monkeypox virus (MPXV) across clinical and environmental matrices in Guangdong Province, China. The researchers examined 23 clinical fluid specimens from 15 mpox patients, 337 surface swabs, 53 domestic wastewater samples, and 498 terminal wastewater samples collected between June 2023 and August 2024. The PMA-qPCR assay selectively amplifies DNA from intact virions and showed quantitative concordance with the standard plaque assay. Infectious MPXV loads were highest in skin lesions and anal swabs, with lower loads in surface samples and no infectious virus detected in wastewater samples. Decay experiments showed that infectious MPXV decreased by more than 99% within 48 h, with accelerated decay under acidic pH and elevated temperature. The study concludes that PMA-qPCR is a practical tool for rapid quantification of infectious MPXV, and direct contact with skin lesions or anal secretions likely dominates transmission, whereas environmental persistence is limited. The findings inform surveillance strategies by highlighting the importance of testing clinical samples for infectious virus and the limited environmental persistence of MPXV. The study's limitations include the lack of comparison with other assays and a larger sample size from different geographical regions, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review investigates the impact of HIV coinfection on mpox patients, focusing on how HIV coinfection and HIV-related immune status influence clinical outcomes, including disease severity and coinfections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis that searched PubMed, Cochrane, EMBASE, and Web of Science from database inception to March 2025 for observational studies comparing clinical outcomes between mpox patients with and without HIV coinfection. The random-effects model was prespecified to pool effect sizes, and dichotomous and continuous outcomes were summarized as risk ratios (RRs) and standardized mean differences (SMDs) with 95% confidence intervals. A total of 29 studies involving 15,522 mpox patients were included.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HIV coinfection is associated with significantly higher hospitalization rates [RR = 1.50, 95% CI (1.17, 1.93)] and mortality [RR = 4.54, 95% CI (2.11, 9.77)]. Mpox patients with HIV coinfection were more frequently coinfected with syphilis, HBV, and HCV and more commonly presented with fever, proctitis, malaise, rectal irritation syndrome, diarrhoea, skin and soft tissue infections, and pneumonia. Pooled blood test results revealed lower levels of albumin, calcium, and haemoglobin, and higher CK-MB levels in the coinfected group. Skin lesions in the perianal region were more common among coinfected patients.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The extent to which HIV coinfection and HIV-related immune status influence clinical outcomes remains incompletely characterized. All subgroup findings are post hoc and hypothesis generating and are limited by the aggregate nature of the data.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Clinicians should consider intensified monitoring and comprehensive supportive care for mpox patients with HIV coinfection, particularly those with suboptimal suppression. Strengthening vaccination and health education in high-risk populations and optimizing strategies for ART initiation remain crucial for mitigating the public health impact of MPXV.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 29 studies involving 15,522 mpox patients found that HIV coinfection is associated with significantly higher hospitalization rates (RR = 1.50, 95% CI (1.17, 1.93)) and mortality (RR = 4.54, 95% CI (2.11, 9.77)). Coinfected patients had more frequent co-infections with syphilis, HBV, and HCV, and presented more commonly with fever, proctitis, and other complications. Blood tests showed lower albumin, calcium, and hemoglobin, and higher CK-MB levels in the coinfected group. Post hoc subgroup analyses suggest suboptimal HIV suppression may be a key determinant of adverse outcomes. The review highlights the need for intensified monitoring and comprehensive care for coinfected patients, particularly those with poor viral suppression, and emphasizes the importance of vaccination and ART optimization in high-risk populations.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the epidemiology, virology, and public health aspects of mpox (formerly monkeypox), a zoonotic viral disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV). The central question focuses on understanding the transmission, vulnerable populations, emerging strains, and prevention methods of mpox.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a comprehensive literature search using databases such as PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. The review critically examines current knowledge on mpox epidemiology, virology, and public health, assessing transmission methods, identifying vulnerable groups, examining new strains, and reviewing prevention and treatment methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Mpox is transmitted from animals to humans and through human-to-human contact, including close physical and sexual contact. High-risk groups include children, immunocompromised individuals, and pregnant women. The emergence of the Clade Ib strain poses a serious threat, particularly in Africa. Vaccines (MVA-BN, LC16m8) and antiviral medications like tecovirimat have been effective in controlling and preventing mpox, but access to these interventions varies globally.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the need for overcoming barriers to access prevention measures, including disparities in access, inadequate surveillance capacity, social stigma, and lack of education and awareness about mpox. The disease remains a global health threat, requiring coordinated response efforts and information sharing.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: To prevent mpox from becoming endemic, it is essential to improve access to prevention measures, enhance surveillance capacity, reduce social stigma, and increase education and awareness. Coordinated global efforts are necessary to respond to outbreaks effectively and share critical information.

analysis.summary_en: This review critically examines the epidemiology, virology, and public health aspects of mpox, a zoonotic viral disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV). Overcoming barriers to prevention measures, enhancing surveillance, reducing stigma, and increasing education are crucial for controlling the disease and preventing it from becoming endemic. Coordinated global efforts are necessary to respond to outbreaks effectively and share critical information.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) highlights the urgent need for a deeper understanding of host-pathogen interactions, and although transcriptional responses to MPXV infection have been characterized, the role of epitranscriptomic regulation particularly N6‐methyladenosine (m6A) modification remains largely unexplored.
analysis.study_design_and_population: We performed an integrated analysis of time‐series transcriptomic and m6A methylome profiles using whole blood samples collected from MPXV‐infected rhesus macaques at 7, 14, and 21 days post‐infection, with distinct animals used at each time point.
analysis.methods: Host gene expression and m6A modification dynamics were examined over the course of infection, differential expression and differential m6A modification analyses were conducted, followed by integrative pathway and immune cell signature profiling.
analysis.main_results: MPXV infection induced sustained host reprogramming, characterized by suppression of immune pathways and activation of metabolic processes, and a global increase in m6A modifications was observed, accompanied by upregulation of the methyltransferase METTL3 and downregulation of demethylases (FTO, ALKBH5) and readers (YTHDF1-3).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Knockdown of METTL3 or YTHDF2 reduced viral replication, suggesting a proviral role for this regulatory circuit, and integrative analysis identified 38 genes with coordinated changes in both transcription and m6A modification across all three time points.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This study reveals m6A epitranscriptomic remodeling as a key correlate of the host response to MPXV infection and nominates DNAJB1 alongside the other 10 dual‐regulated genes as candidate host factors for further mechanistic investigation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Cross‐dataset comparison confirmed core m6A regulatory trends despite heterogeneity across tissues and viral strains, and the study is limited to whole blood samples from rhesus macaques, which may not fully represent human infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of m6A epitranscriptomic remodeling during MPXV infection using time-series transcriptomic and m6A methylome profiles from whole blood samples of MPXV-infected rhesus macaques at 7, 14, and 21 days post-infection. The analysis reveals a global increase in m6A modifications, upregulation of the methyltransferase METTL3, and downregulation of demethylases (FTO, ALKBH5) and readers (YTHDF1-3), which together induce sustained host reprogramming characterized by suppression of immune pathways and activation of metabolic processes. Knockdown of METTL3 or YTHDF2 reduces viral replication, suggesting a proviral role for this regulatory circuit. Integrative analysis identifies 38 genes with coordinated changes in both transcription and m6A modification, with DNAJB1 being the only gene shared between two independent selection strategies. The study concludes that m6A epitranscriptomic remodeling is a key correlate of the host response to MPXV infection and nominates DNAJB1 and other dual-regulated genes as candidate host factors for further mechanistic investigation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Cabotegravir (CAB) is the first long-acting injectable antiretroviral for HIV, administered with rilpivirine, but its real-world safety and effectiveness in Japan were insufficiently documented despite approval based largely on overseas trials.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a 3-year interim analysis of a post-marketing surveillance conducted at 10 institutions in Japan between June 27, 2022 and June 17, 2025, enrolling 121 participants who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to CAB.
analysis.methods: Safety was assessed by the incidence of adverse drug reactions (ADRs) using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment, while effectiveness was evaluated by virologic suppression via log-transformed HIV RNA copies/mL and peripheral CD4+ cell counts.
analysis.main_results: Overall, 76 ADRs were reported in 45 participants (37.19%), with injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain each occurring in 12.40%; four serious ADRs occurred in four participants, and HIV RNA remained suppressed with CD4+ counts maintained throughout follow-up.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as confirming no new safety signals and sustained effectiveness of CAB in real-world Japanese settings, consistent with overseas clinical studies, and highlight the novelty of domestic post-marketing surveillance evidence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results cautiously support the real-world safety and effectiveness of CAB in Japanese PLHIV, addressing a critical evidence gap from prior reliance on overseas trials and informing domestic clinical practice.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size, lack of multiplicity adjustment, and absence of a control group limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting a moderate strength of evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This interim analysis of a Japanese post-marketing surveillance evaluated the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir (CAB), the first long-acting injectable HIV treatment, in 121 virologically suppressed participants across 10 institutions from June 2022 to June 2025. Safety was assessed by adverse drug reactions (ADRs), with 76 events reported in 45 participants (37.19%), predominantly injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each), and four serious ADRs occurred. Effectiveness was confirmed by sustained HIV RNA suppression and stable CD4+ counts throughout follow-up. The authors conclude that CAB demonstrated no new safety signals and maintained effectiveness consistent with overseas trials, addressing a domestic evidence gap. However, the small sample size, lack of multiplicity adjustment, and absence of a control group limit the strength of evidence, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Emerging infectious disease threats may reactivate concerns about employment instability and economic disruption, particularly in regions marked by labor informality, social inequality, and limited social protection. Although the effects of COVID-19 on employment have been widely documented, less is known about how workers perceive the potential labor consequences of future health emergencies. This study aimed to assess perceived labor-related repercussions of a potential new pandemic among workers in Latin America.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from an online survey administered to workers from more than ten Latin American countries between June and July 2022, during the early phase of the 2022 mpox outbreak. Participants were asked about the expected impact of a potential new pandemic on their employment, salary, and overall work situation.
analysis.methods: Associations between perceived labor-related repercussions and sociodemographic and occupational factors were evaluated using Poisson generalized linear models with a log link and robust variance, adjusted for country of residence.
analysis.main_results: Among 850 surveyed workers, 64.2% perceived that a potential new pandemic would have a considerable or very strong impact on their work. In the adjusted analysis, men reported a lower perceived impact than women (aPR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.78-0.97; p = 0.009). Lower perceived impact was also observed among those engaged in virtual work (aPR: 0.64; 95% CI: 0.44-0.93; p = 0.018) and hybrid work (aPR: 0.84; 95% CI: 0.73-0.97; p = 0.017), compared with in-person workers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Perceived labor-related vulnerability in the context of a potential new pandemic was substantial among workers in Latin America. Perceptions differed mainly according to sex and work modality, while occupational-sector estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of subgroup heterogeneity and limited precision.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that future pandemic preparedness strategies in Latin America must address gender and work-modality disparities to effectively mitigate anticipated economic and employment disruptions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference, and by the reliance on self-reported perceptions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the sample size and the use of adjusted models, but the occupational-sector estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of subgroup heterogeneity and limited precision.

analysis.summary_en: This multicountry cross-sectional study assessed Latin American workers' perceptions of labor-related repercussions from a potential new pandemic. Using data from 850 workers across more than ten countries, the authors found that 64.2% perceived a considerable or very strong impact. Adjusted analyses revealed that women reported a higher perceived impact than men, and those in virtual or hybrid work reported lower impacts compared to in-person workers. The study concludes that perceived labor-related vulnerability is substantial in the region, highlighting the need for preparedness strategies that address gender and work-modality disparities.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines under-recognized zoonotic and arboviral transmission in South Africa as a surveillance blind spot, focusing on pathogen detection, local amplification, and the gap between ecological risk and clinical suspicion within endemic systems (A3, A4). The central question addresses how current surveillance approaches fail to identify transmission already underway in these systems rather than novel importations (A3).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative Perspective advocating a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy integrated with a One Health framework, emphasizing earlier alignment between ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability (A5, A6). It critiques South Africa’s reactive, pathogen-specific surveillance outside respiratory virus programmes (A2). The supplied evidence does not report databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, selection methods, or included-study counts.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: South Africa has demonstrated strong capacity for viral detection and genomic analysis, particularly in SARS-CoV-2 surveillance (A1). The review concludes that the most actionable surveillance blind spot is delayed recognition of local amplification in zoonotic and arboviral systems, exemplified by mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses (A3, A4).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights a reactive and pathogen-specific surveillance approach outside respiratory virus programmes, which may miss under-diagnosed local amplification events (A2). It argues that current systems are biased toward high-visibility events, leaving endemic and re-emerging zoonotic and arboviral systems under-monitored (A2, A4). The supplied evidence does not report specific conflicting findings or unresolved mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review prioritizes implementing a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy linked to an integrated One Health framework to enable earlier outbreak response despite tentative early signals (A5, A6). It emphasizes proportionate laboratory escalation, including targeted molecular/serology testing, confirmatory assays, and sequencing when indicated, to align ecological risk with clinical suspicion and test availability (A5).

analysis.summary_en: This Perspective critiques South Africa’s reactive and pathogen-specific surveillance for emerging viral infections, highlighting a critical blind spot in recognizing under-diagnosed local amplification within endemic zoonotic and arboviral systems. While the country excels in viral detection and genomic analysis, particularly for SARS-CoV-2, its approach often misses transmission already underway, exemplified by mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses. The authors advocate for a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy integrated with a One Health framework to align ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability, enabling earlier and proportionate outbreak response despite tentative early signals.

analysis.brief_en: A prospective cohort study published in the Journal of Infection and Public Health analyzed mpox transmission in Bujumbura, Burundi, from July to October 2024. The research included 850 confirmed cases and 7,773 contacts, revealing a median age of 20.3 years with a high proportion of children and young adults. The study found sustained community transmission with a basic reproduction number (R0) of 1.21, driven primarily by sexual contact (58.6%) and household exposure (38.6%). Secondary attack rates were 14.0% among sexual contacts and 13.0% among household contacts. No deaths were reported, though 59.1% of sex workers were HIV-positive. The outbreak peaked in August 2024 and declined afterward. The authors recommend targeted interventions in sexual networks and households, alongside enhanced community monitoring and cross-border regional cooperation.

550747eb89d6bddd8442466f89224d2d7868cf2d.text: 猴痘的演变:从地方性病原体到全球威胁

1f93a1da7b869bc8898c7c5020b8f38ef18dd36c.text: 背景:猴痘 (mpox) 是一种由 mpox 病毒 (MPXV) 引起的重新出现的病毒性人畜共患病,在 2022 年和 2024 年爆发后对全球公共卫生产生了重大影响。本综述探讨了 MPXV 的演变情况,重点关注其基因组组织、流行病学变化、与天花病毒的系统发育关系、人畜共患传播周期以及治疗靶点和疫苗开发的关键干预措施。方法:对 2020 年至 2026 年的文献进行全面的叙述性回顾。使用 Bibliometrix、Scopus Analytics 和 VOSviewer 综合关键主题见解,分析传播动态、临床表现和治疗干预的全球趋势。结果:审查强调了 MPXV 分化为分支 I 和 II,并指出虽然分支 IIb 推动了 2022 年的全球疫情爆发,但毒性更强的分支 Ib 主导了 2024 年的重新爆发。尽管人与人之间的传播已经发展到包括在特定高危人群中快速社区传播,但通过接触绳松鼠和冈比亚袋鼠等宿主,人畜共患病的溢出仍然是主要风险。基因组分析确定了 H3L 等蛋白质中的关键突变,这些突变促进了宿主特异性适应性和免疫逃避。目前的临床管理依赖于支持性护理,针对严重病例有针对性地使用 JYNNEOS 疫苗和 tecovirat 等抗病毒药物。结论:mpox 的持续重新出现强调了采用综合“同一个健康”方法进行监测和大流行防范的必要性。未来的研究必须优先考虑环境野生动物监测、新兴进化枝的基因组监测以及多表位疫苗的开发,以有效减轻人畜共患病的溢出和人类传播。

1adb8dce3760950b9533bec0e494b925a0034e1f.text: 背景:MPX 是一种由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的人畜共患疾病,该病毒在 2022 年爆发后成为全球健康问题。它对免疫功能低下的个人、儿童和孕妇构成重大威胁。疾病在刚果民主共和国(DRC)蔓延并传播到其他国家,导致最近宣布进入公共卫生紧急状态。天花疫苗接种的停止进一步加剧了人群对 MPXV 的脆弱性。为此,最初为天花开发的基于牛痘的疫苗 MVA-BN 和 LC16m8 已被重新用于天花,显示出有前景的安全性和免疫原性。尽管取得了这些进展,但在疫苗分发和了解疫苗在人群中的功效方面仍然存在挑战,特别是在关键高危人群中。现有证据仍然支离破碎,并且主要来自成年人群,孕妇、儿童和青少年的数据有限。这项实时系统评价 (LSR) 旨在评估 MPOX 疫苗在不同人群中的安全性、有效性、有效性和免疫原性,特别关注孕妇、儿童和青少年。方法:我们的目标是根据从开始到目前每两周一次的医学数据库和临床试验注册检索来进行 LSR 和荟萃分析,以系统地识别跨人群的 MPOX 疫苗的相关研究。成对的评审员将独立选择符合条件的研究、提取数据并评估偏倚风险。我们将包括随机临床试验、准实验研究、队列研究、病例对照研究、横断面研究和病例报告。主要结局将包括 MPOX 疫苗在人群中的安全性、有效性/有效性和免疫原性,包括孕妇(包括新生儿结局)、儿童和青少年的结局。将进行荟萃分析,包括预先指定的亚组和敏感性分析。我们将使用建议评估、制定和评估分级 (GRADE) 方法来评估证据的确定性。讨论:本 LSR 将综合人群中mp​​ox 疫苗的证据,特别关注孕妇、儿童和青少年。由于MPOX继续构成全球威胁,特别是在流行和资源匮乏的环境中,及时、严格地评估疫苗性能对于指导公平的免疫政策和母婴健康战略至关重要。系统评价注册:国际系统评价前瞻性登记册 (PROSPERO):CRD42024554330(孕妇)和 CRD42024556977(儿童和青少年)。

14c96b5ecdabc6a1c537bc68d59e6b8d3d4d1737.text: 摘要 背景 Mpox 由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起,仍然是公共卫生的重点。标准 qPCR 可检测病毒 DNA,但无法区分感染性病毒粒子和灭活病毒的残留遗传物质,从而使传播风险评估变得复杂。本研究旨在开发一种快速检测方法,用于定量中国广东省临床和环境基质中的传染性 MPXV。方法 我们开发了一种单叠氮丙啶辅助 qPCR (PMA-qPCR) 检测方法,可选择性扩增完整病毒粒子的 DNA,并将其嵌入广东省疾病预防控制中心监测网络中。我们检查了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 8 月期间收集的 15 名 MPOX 患者的 23 份临床液体样本、来自患者生活环境的 337 份表面拭子和 53 份生活废水样本,以及来自航班和污水处理厂的 498 份航站废水样本。在 25 °C 和 30 °C 不同 pH 条件下评估了衰变动力学,初始病毒载量为 10 3 和 10 4 PFU/mL。结果 PMA-qPCR 可区分感染性病毒和非感染性病毒。与 50 μM PMA 和 0.005% SDS 共孵育可有效阻止非感染性 DNA 的扩增,且检测结果与标准噬菌斑检测结果定量一致。皮肤病变和肛门拭子中的传染性 MPXV 载量最高,是咽喉拭子的 100 多倍。在表面样本中,41.54% (140/337) 通过 qPCR 检测出 MPXV DNA 呈阳性,但其中只有 25.71% (36/140) 含有低载量 (126.79 ± 93.57 PFU/mL) 的传染性病毒。对于废水,来自患者生活环境的家庭样本的 qPCR 检测呈阳性,11.32%(6/53),但未检测到传染性 MPXV。在来自航班或污水处理厂的 498 个航站废水样本中未检测到 MPXV DNA。腐烂实验表明,当初始浓度为10 3 至10 4 PFU/mL时,传染性MPXV在48小时内减少了99%以上,并且在酸性pH和升高的温度下加速腐烂,特别是在较低的初始浓度下。结论 PMA-qPCR 为传染性 MPXV 的快速跨基质定量提供了实用工具。直接接触皮肤病变或肛门分泌物可能是传播的主要途径,而环境持久性有限。建议在收集后 48 小时内对传染性病毒进行检测,因为传染性 MPXV 在此窗口内衰减超过 99%。

763df7f00f3cc1b739ab9ebdd6028405477a1f0a.text: 猴痘:病毒学、流行病学、发病机制、诊断、治疗、疫苗学和公共卫生策略的综合综述

2b6b47c3ea99df20bf7e701aec41b760877e8d84.text: 猴痘(Mpox)由猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起,已从中非和西非的地方性人畜共患病转变为具有全球公共卫生意义的病原体。世界卫生组织(WHO)宣布了两项国际关注的突发公共卫生事件,随后又解除了。Ib 分支继续在刚果民主共和国和邻国出现,重组 MPXV 毒株已被发现,在获得诊断、疫苗和治疗方面的不平等现象仍然存在。这些因素需要进行关键综合,以便为临床实践和公共卫生准备提供信息。本文回顾了 MEDLINE、Embase、世界卫生组织情况报告、美国疾病控制与预防中心和预防监测公报,优先考虑同行评审文献和官方报告,并在引用时标明预印本。MPXV 包括两个具有不同流行病学、临床和病毒学特征的主要分支。分支 Ib 显示载脂蛋白 B mRNA 编辑酶催化亚基 3 一致的突变特征,表明人类持续适应,并导致中非和东非大规模持续爆发。进化枝 IIb 推动了 2022 年全球疫情的爆发,主要是通过男男性接触者之间的性接触。诊断依赖于病变标本的聚合酶链反应,并需要进行全基因组测序来进行亚支和重组表征。Tecovirimat 在针对 I 类疾病的随机试验中没有显示出显着的临床益处,因此治疗指南尚未得到解决。JYNNEOS 针对 clade IIb 提供约 82% 的暴露前有效性,尽管直接 clade Ib 有效性数据仍然有限,并且在高负担非洲环境中公平获得对抗措施仍然严重不足。优先事项包括加强非洲的基因组监测、扩大 JYNNEOS 的访问范围以及紧急分支 Ib 特异性有效性数据。

51c2c82dfc8f065d4862a6cf7230bbe2dd940591.text: MPXV 亚支在人类感染中的毒力差异值得进一步研究;然而,一个关键的限制是缺乏易感的小动物模型。

6af8040637070f1ebaa7f53fb1caffb428a0df00.text: 在这项研究中,我们研究了四种小鼠模型,包括 CAST-EiJ 和三种免疫功能低下模型(C57BL/6 Ifnar −/− 、 C57BL/6 Ifngr −/− 和 C57BL/6 Ifnar −/− / Ifngr −/− )对 MPXV 分支 IIa(WR 7-61 和 US-2003)和 IIb(MA-2022)的易感性隔离。

e852ee5c41b70df1ca3d8d42a8d907573841fa02.text: 在最易受影响的免疫受损小鼠模型 C57BL/6 Ifnar −/− / Ifngr −/− 中,仅在最高剂量 (8.0 log 10 PFU) 下,分支 IIb 分离株就产生严重疾病(40% 致死率)。

eee921f224c24aa53de9ee172177cc85ec690c96.text: 背景:2022-2023 年全球 MPX 爆发凸显了对强大的基因组监测能力的迫切需求,以跟踪 MPXV 的进化和传播动态。方法 在我们已建立的 SARS-CoV-2 测序基础设施的基础上,我们使用 Pacific Biosciences Sequel II 技术实施了基于分子环探针的长读长测序方法,以在美国 (US) 进行全面的 MPXV 基因组监测。从 2024 年 8 月到 2025 年 6 月,我们从 Labcorp 在美国卫生与公众服务部所有 10 个地区收集的残留 MPOX 阳性临床标本中生成了 326 个高质量的全基因组序列。结果我们的分析在 2025 年 1 月和 6 月鉴定了两个含有进化枝 Ib MPXV 的样本,并捕获了进化枝 IIb 多样性的变化趋势,观察到了 13 个不同的谱系。我们还在进化枝 IIb 基因组中发现了多个靠近反向末端重复序列的大缺失(~1.6-17.6kb)实例。APOBEC3 突变分析表明两个分支之间存在人际传播的大量证据。此外,我们观察到,相对于中央保守区,进化枝 IIb 基因组可变区中每千碱基的 APOBEC3 相关 SNP 显着更高(P<0.001)。我们的检测在个体患者的生物重复中表现出很强的重现性,并且美国疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 使用宏基因组测序对选定样本进行并行测序,从而证实了准确性。我们还通过定制模拟证明,我们的检测可以区分所有已知的 MPXV 进化枝和谱系,包括我们在美国未观察到的那些。结论 我们的全国综合监测系统有利于对疫情演变进行实时基因组跟踪,并在 SARS-CoV-2 和 MPXV 方面展示了能力,使该平台能够在未来病原体出现期间快速部署。

badb194882578d9374399b2c21aed3fd9af21820.text: 正在进行的 Mpox(猴痘)爆发凸显了对有效治疗抗体的需求。抗体 VACV-66 与痘苗病毒 D8 蛋白强烈结合,但与 MPXV 同源物 E8L 的交叉反应性显着降低,尽管序列同一性 >95%。在本研究中,我们结合AlphaFold3建模、分子动力学模拟和ASGB-IE自由能计算来研究这一机制,并合理设计针对E8L的高亲和力抗体突变。我们的计算表明,E8L 中的单个 N18D 突变(其中 D8 中的 N18 对应于 E8L 中的 D18)引入了与抗体残基 D34 L 的静电排斥,引发局部构象变化,将关键残基 R20 从 W106 H 和 Y33 L 形成的芳香笼中取代。基于这一机制,D34 L 的饱和突变确定了三个最佳突变(D34 L R、D34 L K 和 D34 L N),它们通过消除静电排斥、恢复 R20 插入芳香笼并形成新的有利相互作用来增强结合自由能。对不同系统中残基 N18 和 R20 的结合自由能贡献的定量分析为该机制提供了额外的支持。这项工作阐明了单个病毒突变如何抑制抗体交叉反应性,并为针对新兴正痘病毒的机制引导抗体优化提供了通用计算策略。已鉴定的 D34 L R、D34 L K 和 D34 L N 突变体代表了实验验证和治疗开发的有希望的候选者。

832362b25d7dd1b3a003085ff9a76cd47bfb30bb.text: Mpox 病毒感染流行病学发病机制及预防

2d62dc6e7e62a5456d5b095d04a8afea7529f1a1.text: 简介:Mpox(以前称为猴痘)是由猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的人畜共患病毒性疾病,猴痘病毒是痘病毒科正痘病毒属的一种有包膜双链 DNA 病毒。该病毒于 1958 年首次被分离出来,但近年来它再次成为全球主要的公共卫生问题,120 多个国家报告了病例。方法:本综述严格审查了目前对 Mpox 的流行病学、病毒学和公共卫生的了解;评估 Mpox 的传播方式;确定人口中的弱势群体;检查新出现的病毒株;并回顾了目前可用于预防和治疗 Mpox 的方法。使用 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 等数据库进行了全面的文献检索。结果:Mpox 通过动物和人与人之间的接触传播给人类,包括密切的身体和性接触。风险最高的群体是儿童、免疫系统受损的人和孕妇。新菌株 Ib 的出现对非洲人民构成了潜在的严重和/或致命威胁,疫苗(MVA-BN、LC16m8)和抗病毒药物(如替科维马)的开发已成功控制和预防 Mpox 疾病,但世界各地获得疫苗和治疗的情况差异很大。讨论:虽然在开发 Mpox 疫苗和抗病毒治疗方面取得了重大进展,但遏制该疾病需要的不仅仅是生物医学干预措施。控制 Mpox 的爆发需要克服获得预防措施和缓解措施的许多障碍,包括获得这些对策的差异、监测能力不足、社会耻辱以及缺乏对 Mpox 的教育和认识。结论:随着越来越多的国家开发出更快的方法来应对疫情、协调应对工作并相互共享重要信息,MPox 现在并将继续成为全球健康威胁。最后,重要的是 MPX 不会流行。

e6f34e7cc2372dee0aa239748b5d21cf5babe613.text: 背景:猴痘 (mpox) 是一种人畜共患病毒性疾病,1958 年首次在猴子中发现,后来于 1970 年在人类中发现。历史上,mpox 在中非和西非流行,2022 年爆发后,它在全球范围内引起了广泛关注,导致在多个国家广泛传播。该疾病通常表现为发烧、疲劳和进行性皮疹,但其临床特征常常与其他皮疹相关病症重叠,使诊断变得复杂。因此,了解人口统计和流行病学预测因素对于支持早期病例识别和公共卫生应对措施至关重要。本研究旨在描述沙特阿拉伯吉达实验室确诊的mpox患者的临床、流行病学和人口统计学特征,并确定出现皮疹的患者中mpox阳性的独立预测因子。方法:使用国家卫生电子监测网络(HESN)的数据进行回顾性横断面分析。2022 年至 2025 年间在吉达政府和私立医院接受过 MPOX PCR 检测的所有出现皮疹的患者均被纳入其中。分析了人口统计学变量和临床症状。使用曼-惠特尼 U 检验和卡方检验进行组间比较。使用多变量逻辑回归来确定mpox阳性的独立预测因素,并使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积(AUC)、敏感性和特异性来评估模型性能。结果:共纳入 443 例患者,其中 147 例(33.2%)mpox 阳性。与 MPOX 阴性患者相比,Mpox 阳性患者的中位年龄显着较高(35 岁 vs. 10 岁)。

3999bf513ed612934e0d8204ef3aac5545d7ee20.text: 背景:猴痘病毒(MPXV)在全球的出现凸显了深入了解宿主与病原体相互作用的迫切需要。尽管对 MPXV 感染的转录反应已经得到表征,但表观转录组调控尤其是 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 修饰的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。方法:我们使用感染后 7、14 和 21 天从感染 MPXV 的恒河猴采集的全血样本,对时间序列转录组和 m6A 甲基化谱进行综合分析,每个时间点使用不同的动物。在感染过程中检查宿主基因表达和 m6A 修饰动态。进行差异表达和差异 m6A 修饰分析,然后进行整合途径和免疫细胞特征分析。结果:MPXV 感染诱导持续的宿主重编程,其特征是抑制免疫途径和激活代谢过程。观察到 m6A 修饰的整体增加,伴随着甲基转移酶 METTL3 的上调和去甲基酶(FTO、ALKBH5)和阅读器(YTHDF1-3)的下调。METTL3 或 YTHDF2 的敲低会减少病毒复制,表明该调节回路具有促病毒作用。综合分析确定了 38 个基因在所有三个时间点的转录和 m6A 修饰方面均发生协调变化。以文献报道的致病途径为重点,我们进一步确定了 11 个双重调节的宿主因子。值得注意的是,DNAJB1 是这两种独立选择策略之间唯一共享的基因。m6A 峰位于转录起始位点附近和 5'UTR 内,与基因表达呈正相关,而编码区修饰则表现出弱负相关。免疫谱系特征显示 T 细胞、NK 和单核细胞/巨噬细胞特征逐渐下降,而 B 细胞特征逐渐增加。尽管组织和病毒株之间存在异质性,但跨数据集比较证实了核心 m6A 调控趋势。结论:这项研究揭示了 m6A 表观转录组重塑是宿主对 MPXV 感染反应的关键相关因素,并提名 DNAJB1 与其他 10 个双重调节基因一起作为进一步机制研究的候选宿主因素。

4e989db11a7536f064573c3799aa2305a25a6e92.text: Mpox 是一种重新出现的正痘病毒感染,其临床与天花相似,但通常不太严重。然而,免疫抑制的个体,包括那些艾滋病毒感染不受控制的个体,有出现严重和非典型MPOX临床表现的风险。我们报告了一名 40 岁尼日利亚艾滋病毒感染者的病例,他没有坚持抗逆转录病毒治疗 (ART),出现广泛的水疱脓疱疹,并演变成植物性溃疡斑块,并伴有发烧、淋巴结肿大和体重显着减轻。实验室评估显示严重的免疫抑制(CD4 <20 个细胞/μL),MPOX 聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 检测呈阳性。他需要 14 周的住院护理,包括支持治疗、广谱抗菌药物和强化伤口处理。Mpox 特异性抗病毒疗法尚不可用。尽管他实现了临床康复,但他出现了炎症后脱发、色素沉着和严重的心理困扰。该病例强调了晚期艾滋病毒感染者患严重和长期感染性痘的风险、通过 PCR 进行早期识别和微生物学确认的重要性,以及多学科支持护理的必要性,包括感染控制、伤口和皮肤管理、ART 优化和心理健康支持。还应该为患有严重疾病的患者提供更容易获得的 Mpox 特异性抗病毒药物。

d283861b65ee3109b4eadae638b2253d557c0ef9.text: Cabotegravir (CAB) 是一种整合酶链转移抑制剂,也是第一种针对人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的长效注射型抗逆转录病毒药物,与利匹韦林 (rilpivirine) 一起给药。由于日本的批准主要依赖于海外和国际合作试验,因此国内现实世界的证据仍然有限。这项研究评估了 CAB 在日本艾滋病毒感染者 (PLHIV) 中的现实安全性和有效性。这项中期分析(2022 年 6 月 27 日和 2025 年 6 月 17 日)是参与 HIV 相关药物合作调查的机构对接受 CAB 治疗的日本 PLHIV 进行的上市后监测的一部分。通过药物不良反应(ADR)的发生率来评估安全性。使用 Fisher 精确检验和 χ2 检验检查 ADR 发生率与背景特征之间的关联,无需进行多重性调整。使用通过对数转换的 HIV RNA 拷贝数/mL 和外周 CD4+ 细胞计数评估的病毒学抑制来评估有效性。安全性和有效性分析组分别包括 121 名和 117 名参与者;大多数年龄在20岁以上,其中超过96%是男性参与者。总体而言,45 名参与者 (37.19%) 报告了 76 起 ADR。最常见的不良反应是注射部位疼痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛(各 12.40%)。报告医生未明确认为与 CAB 无关的四种严重 ADR 发生在 4 名参与者身上:乙型肝炎再激活、猴痘、梅毒和 2 型糖尿病。按参与者特征进行的分层分析显示,年龄 ≥ 30 岁至 < 40 岁(p = 0.038)、无过敏(p = 0.016)和有合并症(p = 0.045)的参与者中 ADR 发生率较高。在整个随访过程中,HIV RNA 拷贝仍然受到抑制,CD4+ 细胞计数也维持在与治疗开始时相当的水平。这项中期分析表明,CAB 疗法是安全的,没有新的安全信号,而且是有效的,持续的病毒学抑制和稳定的 CD4+ 细胞计数证明了这一点。这些发现与海外和国际合作临床研究报告的结果一致。对于人类免疫缺陷病毒 (PLHIV) 感染者来说,每天服用多种口服药物可能具有挑战性。卡博特韦 (Cabotegravir) 与利匹韦林 (rilpivirine) 联合给药,是第一种长效注射 HIV 治疗药物,可每月或每 2 个月注射一次。它在日本的批准主要基于海外和国际合作研究,日本的真实临床证据有限。为了弥补这一差距,我们进行了上市后监测,以确认卡博特韦对日本艾滋病毒感染者的安全性和有效性。这是一项为期 3 年的上市后监测分析,包括日本 10 家机构的 121 名参与者,这些参与者在改用卡博特韦之前已被病毒学抑制了 6 个多月。在随访期间,45名参与者经历了76种药物不良反应(37.19%),包括注射部位疼痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛(各12.40%)、口腔疱疹、高胆固醇、注射部位增厚或硬化、发烧和白细胞计数减少(各2.48%)。这些发现与之前的临床研究报告一致。年龄≥30岁至<40岁、无过敏以及患有其他疾病的参与者中观察到较高的药物不良反应发生率。大多数与卡博特韦相关的药物不良反应发生在治疗开始后 180 天内。在整个随访期间,HIV RNA 拷贝仍然受到抑制,CD4+ 细胞计数维持在与治疗开始时相似的水平。总体而言,这些结果证实了卡博特韦在日本的现实安全性和有效性。

f6a06713af46d3cfef49aad6f0b712a67b9223c4.text: 卡博特韦 (CAB) 是第一种长效注射型艾滋病毒抗逆转录病毒药物,与利匹韦林一起服用,但尽管其批准主要基于海外试验,但其在日本的实际安全性和有效性尚未得到充分记录。

000a5c457c6641f821d22c0567fe13856f0d4a0a.text: 这是对 2022 年 6 月 27 日至 2025 年 6 月 17 日期间在日本 10 家机构进行的上市后监测进行的为期 3 年的中期分析,招募了 121 名参与者,这些参与者在转用 CAB 之前已受到病毒学抑制超过 6 个月。

6705d410975916350a8bdd8cf14584a231bd115c.text: 安全性通过使用 Fisher 精确检验和 χ2 检验(无需多重调整)的药物不良反应 (ADR) 发生率来评估,而有效性通过对数转换的 HIV RNA 拷贝数/mL 和外周 CD4+ 细胞计数的病毒学抑制来评估。

0c83aa98d2c31051fa8cbd2e35b6e856fa7f157a.text: 总体而言,45 名参与者(37.19%)报告了 76 种不良反应,其中注射部位疼痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛各占 12.40%;4 名参与者发生了 4 次严重的 ADR,并且在整个随访过程中,HIV RNA 仍然受到抑制,CD4+ 计数保持不变。

d4ff5ec8a861dcab4fa839879c6a1427cb3b1827.text: 作者将这些发现解释为确认 CAB 在日本现实环境中没有新的安全信号和持续有效性,与海外临床研究一致,并强调了国内上市后监测证据的新颖性。

db51f7f76e8596e2cb1c570f528099ec4fda6abf.text: 这些结果谨慎地支持了 CAB 在日本 PLHIV 中的现实安全性和有效性,解决了先前依赖海外试验的关键证据差距,并为国内临床实践提供了信息。

e6b3bb5e6b24765267d8b979e17b48b569fb123b.text: 该研究的样本量小、缺乏多重性调整以及缺乏对照组限制了因果推断和普遍性,需要中等强度的证据。

395403ab0123b0a4ec873d65fb5472bcb2e430c8.text: 在潜在的新流行病背景下拉丁美洲的就业脆弱性:多国横断面研究。

e845b8654e1e10f1e6b503ef58a0c7c9c430a0a1.text: 简介:新出现的传染病威胁可能会重新引发人们对就业不稳定和经济混乱的担忧,特别是在劳动力非正规、社会不平等和社会保护有限的地区。尽管 COVID-19 对就业的影响已被广泛记录,但人们如何看待未来突发卫生事件对劳动力的潜在影响却知之甚少。这项研究旨在评估拉丁美洲工人中潜在的新流行病对劳工相关的影响。方法:利用 2022 年 6 月至 7 月(2022 年 MPOX 爆发早期阶段)对来自 10 多个拉丁美洲国家的工人进行的在线调查的二手数据进行了一项分析性横断面研究。参与者被问及潜在的新流行病对其就业、工资和整体工作状况的预期影响。使用具有对数链接和稳健方差的泊松广义线性模型评估了感知到的与劳动力相关的影响与社会人口和职业因素之间的关联,并根据居住国进行了调整。结果:在 850 名接受调查的工人中,64.2% 的人认为潜在的新流行病将对他们的工作产生相当大或非常强烈的影响。在调整后的分析中,男性报告的感知影响低于女性(aPR:0.87;95% CI:0.78-0.97;p = 0.009)。与现场工作人员相比,从事虚拟工作(aPR:0.64;95% CI:0.44-0.93;p = 0.018)和混合工作(aPR:0.84;95% CI:0.73-0.97;p = 0.017)的人的感知影响也较低。在修订后的调整模型中,与医护人员相比,没有职业部门显示出统计上的显着差异,尽管食品部门的点估计值较高,但不显着。结论:在潜在的新流行病背景下,拉丁美洲工人感知到的与劳工相关的脆弱性很大。看法的差异主要取决于性别和工作方式,而由于亚组异质性和有限的精度,职业部门的估计值应谨慎解释。

cf7ed2c4596cdddb8335a051b0f2305ea770ede3.text: 南非的下一个病毒出现可能已经在这里:作为监测盲点的人畜共患和虫媒病毒传播未被充分认识

f93aa8df34a5bed6cf88fccb79f74b5b369ba68b.text: 南非在病毒检测和基因组分析方面表现出了卓越的能力,最明显的是通过严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 基因组学和废水监测。然而,在呼吸道病毒计划之外,该国应对新出现的病毒感染的方法仍然相对反应性、病原体特异性,并且偏向于高可见度事件。本观点认为,南非最可行的监测盲点不仅是新型病原体的输入,而且是对地方性和重新出现的人畜共患病和虫媒病毒系统中已经发生的传播的延迟认识。通过使用典型的例子——mpox、克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒、裂谷热病毒和被忽视的神经侵袭性虫媒病毒——我们提出,南非的“出现”通常采取诊断不足的局部放大形式,而不是戏剧性的首次出现。我们提倡一种基于综合征的诊断指导策略,与综合的 One Health“信号到行动”框架相结合,将临床综合征与兽医事件、病媒和环境监测以及按比例的实验室升级(有针对性的分子/血清学检测、验证性检测和有指示时的测序)联系起来。目标不是不加区别地进行多重检测,而是更早地协调生态风险、临床怀疑和检测可用性,以便在出现初步的早期信号且在人类广泛感染或疫情加速爆发之前就开始应对疫情。

176b306cc4be96cd7696c93572c2d2e5b4483107.text: 该审查将南非未被充分认识的人畜共患病和虫媒病毒传播视为监测盲点,重点关注病原体检测、局部放大以及流行系统内生态风险与临床怀疑之间的差距(A3、A4)。核心问题是,当前的监测方法如何无法识别这些系统中已经发生的传播,而不是新的输入(A3)。

d21586ee8ef951304675918afc7aab593796af5d.text: 该综述是一种叙述性视角,提倡基于综合征的诊断指导策略与同一个健康框架相结合,强调生态风险、临床怀疑和测试可用性之间的早期协调(A5、A6)。它批评了南非在呼吸道病毒项目之外的反应性、针对病原体的监测(A2)。提供的证据不报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准、选择方法或纳入研究计数。

64a4adab7ba2472a1a54d65eb695d369e67b238c.text: 南非在病毒检测和基因组分析方面表现出了强大的能力,特别是在 SARS-CoV-2 监测方面 (A1)。审查得出的结论是,最可行的监测盲点是延迟识别人畜共患病和虫媒病毒系统中的局部放大,例如mpox、克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒、裂谷热病毒和被忽视的神经侵袭性虫媒病毒(A3、A4)。

a8c08dfc64d4c791e9d1370576a321c9ae898e65.text: 该审查强调了呼吸道病毒计划之外的反应性和病原体特异性监测方法,该方法可能会错过诊断不足的局部放大事件(A2)。它认为,当前的系统偏向于高可见度事件,导致地方性和重新出现的人畜共患病和虫媒病毒系统得不到监测(A2,A4)。所提供的证据并未报告具体的相互矛盾的发现或未解决的机制。

d8f6f994503140758cf65895cd51be70ce0c52c6.text: 该审查优先考虑实施一种与综合“同一个健康”框架相关的基于症状的诊断指导策略,以便在出现初步信号的情况下能够更早地应对疫情(A5、A6)。它强调按比例进行实验室升级,包括有针对性的分子/血清学检测、验证性检测和有指示时的测序,以使生态风险与临床怀疑和检测可用性保持一致(A5)。

251668b2127256ab56d367ae92351d13e037bd94.text: SemVac:由法学硕士支持的语义疫苗学范式,用于抗原发现

4695009fb99ebad712c1f782f640cb890b8aff1c.text: 反向疫苗学使得基于序列的抗原发现成为可能,但它忽视了生物医学文献中蕴含的丰富语义知识。在这里,我们建立了语义疫苗学 (SemVac),这是一种利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 直接从科学文本预测保护性抗原的范例。在精心策划的抗原数据集上对 14 个最先进的法学硕士进行基准测试表明,基于文本推理的方法在精度上匹配或超过了专门的深度学习模型,同时对功能模糊的蛋白质提供了卓越的鲁棒性。有趣的是,显式推理模式(例如思维链)会增加召回率,但会持续降低精度,揭示了生物发现任务中的过度推理陷阱。SemVac 应用于 Mpox 病毒的完整蛋白质组,可重现已知的保护性抗原,并识别以前未识别的候选抗原,例如 B20R,我们的语义分析将其与免疫逃避和结构暴露联系起来。这项工作将文献驱动的语义推理作为传统疫苗学的有力补充,对人工智能辅助的科学发现具有广泛的影响。

25f0c84878fe54e25b84cf0e8a9cac50e8922e01.text: Tonix Paper 推出三种用于 Mpox 疫苗研究的新小鼠模型 - Stock Titan

0a8d75c22274febf25aa604baaf5ff7ffc61c925.text: 2026 年 7 月 15 日,Tonix Pharmaceuticals 宣布在《病毒学杂志》上发表了一项同行评审的研究,详细介绍了用于 MPOX 研究的新小鼠模型。这项在 Tonix 进行的研究确定了三种新的小鼠模型,包括 CAST/EiJ 和 C57BL/6 品系,以研究 MPOX 发病机制。研究发现,在这些模型中,2022 年爆发的 clade IIb mpox 病毒的毒性比历史上 2003 年的 clade IIa 低约 100 至 100,000 倍,据报道,clade IIa 的病死率为 11%,clade IIb 的病死率为 0.2%。这些模型支持医疗对策的评估,包括研究性候选疫苗 TNX-801。该论文解决了用于 MPOX 研究的合适小动物模型的关键差距,并引起了积极的市场反应,Tonix 股票在发表之日上涨了 4.97%。

ba7491a7036b5e8c0bda6722ddb1e7c837d58e2f.text: 该研究是在实验室小鼠中进行的,特别是四种模型:CAST/EiJ(野生型和免疫缺陷变体)、C57BL/6 Ifnar?/? (IFN-α 受体缺陷),C57BL/6 Ifngr?/? (IFN-γ 受体缺陷)和 C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?研究重点是 MPXV 进化枝 IIa(WR 7-61,US-2003)和进化枝 IIb(MA-2022)分离株。

d90fa7db4e5749c9f86989931992fc14215a3ec6.text: 《病毒学杂志》上发表的一项研究比较了 MPXV clade IIa 和 clade IIb 分离株在多种小鼠模型中的毒力。该研究是一项经过证实的科学研究。

8cdc2ea018b14bfda708a71a6caf46d299bf342f.text: 在 CAST/EiJ 小鼠中,进化枝 IIa (WR 7-61) 引起严重的剂量依赖性疾病和高死亡率(7.0 log10PFU 时高达 100%),而进化枝 IIb (MA-2022) 仅引起轻微疾病,在同等剂量下没有死亡。在免疫缺陷模型(C57BL/6 Ifnar?/? 和 Ifngr?/?)中,进化枝 IIa 引起快速、致命的疾病,而进化枝 IIb 只引起轻微的疾病。在最易受影响的模型(C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?)中,进化枝 IIb 仅在最高剂量(8.0 log10PFU)下才会引起致命性疾病,死亡率为 40%。研究报告称,在这些模型中,进化枝 IIa 的毒性比进化枝 IIb 强 100 至 100,000 倍。

8164d94398ea040476c27780771a04157ccde4cd.text: 该研究是发表在《病毒学杂志》上的一篇经过同行评审的研究文章。作者使用了既定方法,包括计算机分析、体外表征和四种不同小鼠模型的感染。这些发现作为实验的明确结果呈现。该研究并未涉及这些模型中 Ia 或 Ib 分支的毒力。
